main.headline: Two promises made in 2006. Still kept today.
main.body: Lakshya was born from a group of young activists who believed that environmental health and human dignity are inseparable. Since April 12, 2006, we've operated at the intersection of community empowerment and ecological responsibility — not as charity, but as partnership.
main.body2: By enabling villagers, women, and students to become stakeholders in their local environments, we promote systemic change that thrives long after our initial support.

missionVision.missionBody: To promote sustainable, community-driven social and environmental health across cities and villages. We seek to protect nature, clean urban centers, and educate underprivileged children while equipping women with livelihood resources to design a dignified, self-reliant future.
missionVision.visionBody: A balanced society where human development and nature coexist in harmony. We envision an India where environmental cleanliness is a shared habit, women stand as confident community stakeholders, and quality primary education is accessible to the very last child.

timeline.title: The Spark
timeline.description: Lakshya was registered on April 12, 2006, by a passionate group of young activists committed to solving grassroots environmental and social challenges.

timeline.title: Adhaar Classes Launch
timeline.description: Recognizing that long-term social changes start with education, we initiated free pre-nursery and primary classes reaching children in underprivileged rural sectors.

timeline.title: Vaidehi Empowerment Initiative
timeline.description: Began livelihood training and nutritional support for adolescent girls, helping them gain job skills and develop confidence in designing their own futures.

timeline.title: Litter Free India Campaign
timeline.description: Organized and expanded environment cleaning activities into the "Litter Free India" movement, collaborating with city developers and transit authorities.

timeline.title: Milestone Reached
timeline.description: Now supporting 6 active programmes, managing 3 regional offices, and having directly impacted over 10,000+ lives across the country.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We believe in absolute transparency and accountability. Every contribution is directed where it creates the maximum impact.

values.title: Inclusion
values.description: No voice is too small. We work hand-in-hand with last-mile communities, giving girls, villagers, and children a lead role.

values.title: Sustainability
values.description: Our environmental plans focus on circular local economies and long-term habits, rather than short-term fixes.

values.title: Impact
values.description: We measure success not by funds raised, but by lives transformed, trees growing, and communities becoming self-sufficient.
